input.question: You are the vision agent in a flood-response exercise. This is an overhead image of a city street area. Report what you can see on the roads: whether there is floodwater on them, the water depth on the road in inches (0 if dry), whether an ordinary passenger car could safely drive through, and whether there is a fire. Give your confidence from 0 to 1 and one short reason based on visible cues.

output.reason: Aerial view shows muddy floodwater covering the street and surrounding parked cars up to their lower doors, indicating unsafe depth for passenger vehicles.
